title: Dev order: ship the restored_baseline fallback specified on 2026-04-13
intent: Add a dev order for the automatic refined -> restored_baseline fallback that docs/archive/2026/status/RECOVERY_BASELINE.md specified on 2026-04-13, marked CRITICAL, and whose own status table still reads 'Ship as fallback | PENDING'. The edge_to_dxf blueprint lane's default extraction produces substantially thinner output than the same code with isolate_body=False, measured on four plans and a 24-page document family. Ships alongside it a method record (VECTORIZER_WORKING_RECIPE.md) and a correction to the forensic audit already on main. Documentation only: three Markdown files, no code, and the order authorizes no implementation and no merge.
behavior_change: None. Two new Markdown files under docs/handoffs/ and one modified Markdown file under docs/audit/. No code, configuration, workflow or test is touched. A runnable border-strip script was present in an earlier revision of this branch and has been REMOVED: a script that nothing imports, filed beside an order, is reviewed on its own merits in a separate PR rather than merged inside a documentation change. The order explicitly states it is not an authorization to merge.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds two Markdown documents and modifies one. (1) DEV_ORDER_RESTORED_BASELINE_FALLBACK.md specifies the fallback at the exact return site, carries the April benchmark beside a 2026-09-19 re-run, repeats April's do-not-modify constraints verbatim, states the output-size cost up front, and records five named gaps in the _is_unacceptable predicate that must be mapped before implementation. (2) VECTORIZER_WORKING_RECIPE.md records the method that produces usable output today, with a lineage and scale banner at its head. (3) VECTORIZER_PROVENANCE_FORENSIC_2026-09-17.md is corrected: D-13 is NOT attributed to any commit and its cause is recorded as UNKNOWN; D-10 is a candidate in the edge_to_dxf lane only, unproven and unbisected; the 'Nothing executed' method header is scoped per section.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: RECOVERY_BASELINE.md diagnosed the regression but was archived on 2026-05-02 with its Step 2 unimplemented; no order exists asking for it. Verified 2026-09-19 that no automatic refined -> restored_baseline fallback exists anywhere in services/api/app, and that blueprint_async_router.py:147 still defaults to mode='refined'.
diff_articulation.review_response_2026_09_19: Second review round. (P1) The dev order's section 9 still re-pointed D-13 and D-10 at the April regression after the audit had withdrawn that attribution; section 9 is rewritten to withdraw it and record D-13's cause as UNKNOWN. (P1) The commit hashes f49ead1d and 86c49526 DO NOT RESOLVE -- verified by git cat-file -t, and the audit's own section 5.3 already said so while 42 citations across these files used them as anchors. New section 0a in the dev order records the verified twin 9cc92ba9 (2026-04-12 15:42, same subject) and WITHDRAWS the last-good-state anchor entirely: no commit at 2026-04-11 01:41 touches edge_to_dxf.py, and the defensible lower bound is 38e609bd (2026-04-09 14:33). (P1) The audit's 'Nothing executed' header is now scoped per section -- read-only for sections 1-11, execution-based for the dated addenda from section 12. (P2) Step 4's mechanism corrected: _remove_page_borders_early went 7,368 -> 7,368 on the cuatro and removed nothing; the body dies at too_small (:943), and on L-00 at child_contour (:947). (P2) '15-page sample' corrected to 24-page. (P2) Lineage and scale banner added at the head of the recipe; extent tables marked as output coordinates at target_height_mm=500. (P3) D-10 reworded from 'probable shared root cause' to 'candidate cause in the edge_to_dxf lane only, unproven and unbisected'. (P3) Soundhole universality claims scoped to the plan family examined. (P3) The _is_unacceptable predicate now carries five named gaps that must be mapped before implementation.

files.intent: Record the method that demonstrably produces usable output today, with every number measured rather than asserted. At least three documents in this repository describe a 'secret sauce' and they disagree; two describe behaviour the code no longer has. This one states the two rules that matter, the single flag that carries them, the parameters, the domain boundaries, and explicitly what the recipe does NOT give you.
